summary.t: Personalised Pine Wood Initial with gold acrylic name

text.t:
A delicate and enchanting piece, crafted from pine wood, featuring a large initial and the name in gold acrylic, which gives it an elegant and sophisticated touch.
The combination of the natural beauty of wood with the shine of gold makes this piece unique and special, perfect for decorating children's rooms, personalising spaces, or giving a meaningful keepsake.
